archetypes.name: quiet-stdout
archetypes.rationale: Progress hooks depend on raw stdout despite inherited quiet-mode state.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the progress report CLI and hook-capture path. Focus on whether stdout remains the primary deliverable under inherited quiet-mode environment variables, and whether the regression would fail if quiet routing were reintroduced. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
